text:
zainab: TidalTech reached out — they want a co-validated perf/W bakeoff for our 30B model on their TT-XL boards. primary asks: steady-state perf/W, tokens/sec, and kernel stability under long-run. want to line up run plan + reproducible bundle.
leo: cool. what configs are they proposing? single-stream + streaming batch? sequence length?
zainab: they care about streaming gen (avg seq 6k) and batch embeddings. target streaming throughput ~90rps/card, embeddings 700rps. headline is perf/W over 1h trimmed window.
tidal-eng: Tidal can provide an external meter + IPMI. firmware label tt-xl-2026-05. kernel tune name: ttxl-lowpower-v2. we'll share a flash script and a telemetry manifest.
harper_pm: PM ask: we need a reproducible artifact that their QA can run locally. include docker tag, env.sample, and run.sh. we'll own the bundle on our side.
leo: infra notes: run on 3 identical nodes in perf-pool, isolated VLAN, local collector. NTP and monotonic clocks enforced. plan a 15m warmup, measure last 45m of a 1h run. power sampled 1s, thermals 5s.
ops-bot: Lab slots suggested: 2026-08-11 19:30 PT or 2026-08-12 03:00 PT. Pick preferred slot.
zainab: prefer evening 2026-08-11 19:30 PT. ops-bot: booking confirmed: tidal-bay-7 2026-08-11T19:30:00-07:00 booking_id=TB-12077
comm s: (typo)
comm s: small ask from comms: if numbers look good we want a short two-line marketplace blurb and a co-blog. need embargo window details.
harper_pm: legal asked for 72h embargo after we hand over validated numbers. is that OK with Tidal?
tidal-eng: 72h is fine. we'll sign the MOU.
leo: collector schema required (string keys): run_id, partner, model, kernel_label, firmware_id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, thermal_max_c, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, panic_count, raw_power_series_url, artifact_url, bench_git_sha.
zainab: add kv_cache_warmup and measured_window_start/end. also include perf_env string with docker tag and runtime flags.
leo: sample run command for the runner I'll put in the repo:
```
RUN_ID="tidal-ttxl-2026-08-11-01"
./bench_stream --model redwood-30b --seq 6144 --batch 2 --streaming --duration 3600 --warmup 900 --collector http://collector.internal:8200/post --tag "$RUN_ID"
```
leo: calibration note: do a 5m fixed-load calibration at start to detect power sensor drift. I'll add --calibrate flag to bench.
tidal-eng: kernel knobs in tt xl tune: power_cap=220, prefetch=off, thread_affinity=compact. flash script will expose toggle_ttxl_tune.sh.
ops-bot: Preflight reminder: 2026-08-09T09:00:00-07:00. reminder_id=PRF-87299
zainab: risks: thermal plateau after ~40m on earlier TT-XL silicon, powermeter timestamp skew, network egress variance. mitigations: preflight thermal stress, synchronize powermeter to NTP, isolated ingest gateway.
leo: one gotcha: kv cache warmup can bias perf/W early. we will only compute metrics in trimmed window and also record raw series so partners can re-trim.
harper_pm: action items: zainab -> partner coordination + MOU; leo -> bench script + collector mapping + baseline hosted runs; tidal-eng -> kernel scripts + powermeter manifest; comms -> PR template + marketplace blurb draft; ops-bot -> lab booking + VLAN. target dry-run 2026-08-09 09:00 PT; official run 2026-08-11 19:30 PT.
comm s: i'll draft blurb: "Redwood Inference + TidalTech: optimized 30B inference on TT-XL with industry-leading perf/W" and share draft after numbers.
leo: I'll push reproducibility bundle to experiments/tidal/ttxl-bakeoff/ with docker tag redwood/bench:2026-08-11 and a README. ping here when uploaded and I'll run the preflight.
tidal-eng: We'll also provide a small validation script that checks model logits against a host baseline to ensure kernel tune doesn't alter outputs beyond tiny epsilon.
zainab: thanks all. i'll post a one-page runbook to the repo in ~1.5h and tag @tidal-eng for preflight. :rocket:
